title.en: The Jingyuan Mutiny and the court at Fengtian
title.zh: 泾原兵变与奉天朝廷

summary.en:
An expected campaign reward could become a political crisis. In 783, soldiers of the Jingyuan army passing through Chang’an rebelled after receiving less than they expected. Emperor Dezong fled the capital and took refuge at Fengtian. The later Zizhi tongjian describes the hurried flight and the gathering of defenders around the court.

Read this as a story about resources as well as commanders. David Graff’s study connects late Tang soldiers’ compensation to military loyalty and the taxes that sustained armies. The episode reveals why a single imperial color on a map cannot show how precarious the court’s control could be.
summary.zh:
一次出征赏赐也可能引发政治危机。783年，途经长安的泾原军士因所得不及预期而哗变，唐德宗逃出京师，避难奉天。后出的《资治通鉴》记述了仓促出奔以及守军逐渐集结的过程。

这不仅是将领的故事，也关乎财赋。历史学者David A. Graff的研究将唐后期士兵的待遇同军事忠诚、维持军队的赋税联系起来。这一事件说明，地图上同一种帝国颜色无法表达朝廷控制可能有多么脆弱。

dateNote.en: 783 CE dates the mutiny and refuge. The chronicle uses a Chinese lunar month; no Gregorian month or day is asserted. Fengtian is represented near present-day Qian County.
dateNote.zh: 783年为兵变与出奔奉天之年。编年史使用农历月份，此处不将其换算为公历月日。奉天以今乾县附近的代表点标示。

title.en: Han: an enduring model of empire
title.zh: 汉：延续深远的帝国模式

summary.en: Han rulers rebuilt imperial power after Qin’s fall, developing a bureaucracy and a political culture shaped by classical learning. Chang’an became a major capital, while diplomacy and military campaigns linked the court with Central Asia. Sima Qian’s historical writing helped establish models for later dynastic histories. Elite tombs preserve household models, entertainment and beliefs about the afterlife, revealing social worlds beyond government alone. Han rule was interrupted by the Xin dynasty and later restored from Luoyang. Its institutional legacy lasted much longer than any stable set of imperial borders.
summary.zh: 汉在秦亡后重建帝国，以官僚制度和经典学问塑造政治文化。长安成为大都会，外交与战争又将朝廷和中亚联系起来。司马迁的著述为后世史书提供重要范式。墓葬中的住宅、乐舞和来世形象，还展现了政治之外的社会生活。汉的统治曾被新朝打断，后来以洛阳为都城恢复；制度影响远比某一时刻的疆界持久。

title.en: Chen Sheng · a conscript becomes a king
title.zh: 陈胜 · 从戍卒到王

labelI18n.zh: 大泽乡地区，起事的代表地点

summary.en: Chen Sheng enters Sima Qian’s history as a hired farm worker with ambitions beyond his assigned place. In 209 BCE, he and Wu Guang turned a group of men sent to frontier service into an armed challenge to Qin rule. Taking Chen, the insurgents proclaimed a restored Chu kingdom with Chen Sheng as king. Their success encouraged other commanders to establish power of their own, making a common rebellion difficult to direct. The biography records both the force of his challenge to inherited rank and the violence of his brief kingship. It offers a story of political possibility whose early promise did not guarantee durable institutions.
summary.zh: 司马迁笔下的陈胜，最初是怀有远大志向的佣耕者。公元前209年，他与吴广把一队被征发戍边的人组织成反抗秦朝的武装。攻占陈地后，起事者建立张楚政权，拥陈胜为王。他的成功推动其他将领另立权力中心，也使共同的反秦事业难以统一指挥。传记既保存了对世袭地位的挑战，也记述其短暂王权中的暴力。这个故事呈现了政治变动的可能，同时说明最初的动员并不能保证制度长久。

title.en: Gao Shi at the county desk
title.zh: 县衙案前的高适

summary.en:
A county job brought Gao Shi close to the machinery of Tang government. Appointed to Fengqiu in 749, he described an office where even a small jurisdiction generated deadlines, formal greetings and punishments. His poem “Written at Fengqiu” turns from the humiliation of bowing before superiors to the distress of flogging ordinary people. At home, the speaker’s family laughs at the life he has acquired. The scene gives local administration a voice quite different from a court proclamation.

Gao left the post in 752 and later served on a frontier staff. Reading this episode beside Du Fu and Bai Juyi connects poetic ambition with the daily work of government. The poem offers a crafted account of an official’s discomfort; its force comes from bringing hierarchy, household conversation and the people subject to punishment into the same frame.
summary.zh:
749年，高适出任封丘县尉，进入唐代地方行政的日常。《封丘作》写小县也有繁多期限，要迎送上官，还要执行刑罚。诗人从向上司屈身的难堪，写到鞭打百姓的悲伤；回家诉说，家人却笑他如今的处境。县衙的权力关系、普通人的遭遇和家庭里的对话，就这样进入同一首诗。

高适于752年离职，后来进入边地幕府。把这段经历与杜甫、白居易的作品并读，可以看到文学志向怎样与治理事务相遇。诗中的官员带有作者经营的自我形象，并非县务档案；它仍让读者贴近地方官在等级、职责与同情之间感到的冲突。

dateNote.en: 749–752 marks the inspected chronology of the Fengqiu appointment and resignation. The poem is associated with the posting; no exact composition day is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 749—752年对应所核查的封丘任职与辞官时段。诗与这段任职经历相关，不指定确切写作日期。
